law: Core owns intelligence truth. EXI presents/composes truth. Presentation is not Core capability.

correctExiResponsibility: Single manager-facing narrative: what changed → why it matters → attention → options → recommend → next
Choosing which existing field to display (NBA > Brief > Advisor)
Conversational parity with Advisor without stealing Stage focus
Safe unknown when no grounded source exists
potentialCoreLeakage: Selecting a recommendation winner among NBA/Brief/Advisor is presentation precedence, not Core recommendation intelligence — but it can be mistaken for Core priority/recommendation authority
Epistemic-looking confidence on composed fields is Advisor/EXI evidenceState, not EI:3 SemanticConfidence

correctExiResponsibility: Honest unknown when no recorded edges exist
Never stuffing causes into Advisor Why
potentialCoreLeakage: Mapping relation kinds to epistemic assumption vs relationship (Core leakage: assigning epistemic state)
primaryContributor when inbound count === 1 (not causal ranking; Core leakage: implied cause selection)
composeRecordedChain A→B→C from fixture links without per-edge Core provenance (Core leakage: assembling causal chain)
Treating constrained-by/blocks as the constraint set (Core leakage: determining constraints from unlabeled graph rather than a Constraint model)

correctExiResponsibility: Refusing to claim EI:4 is live
Comparable options only via recorded explored-by parent
potentialCoreLeakage: Comparability graph walk (Core leakage: comparing alternatives)
Phrase extraction of gains/risks/constraints/assumptions from scenario summary copy (Core leakage: deriving trade-off meaning from prose rather than EI:4 ScenarioTradeoff)
Preferred option if recommendation copy names exactly one option (Core leakage: ranking/preference from presentation text)

assumptionTest.question: Can Core, without EXI wording, receive an executive claim and determine fact vs assumption vs prediction vs unknown from canonical evidence?
assumptionTest.reason: createExecutiveClaim requires the caller to pass type. It validates FACT has evidence+provenance and derives SemanticConfidence. It does not classify unlabeled statements.

uncertaintyPropagation.dataToDecision: each subsystem assigns independently; no Data→Problem→Scenario→Recommendation→Decision uncertainty object
